goal.title: Build the remaining human-rendering operational items
goal.outcome: Make human findings projections automatically available in interactive review sessions, continuously validate generated HTML in Chromium and its accessibility tree, publish a current successor research record without mutating history, and clean only stale browser runtime state safely.
constraints: Canonical JSON remains the only authority; Markdown/HTML remain disposable untrusted projections.
Interactive sessions default to transient Markdown; HTML requires explicit share or destination intent; non-interactive sessions do not implicitly publish projections.
Use the existing csm-review projection entrypoint, csm-browse harness, and renderer security policy.
Preserve the terminal historical research JSON exactly; no replacement, rename, or in-place wording edits.
Preserve .agents/plans, .agents/research, and .agents/reviews artifacts during cleanup unless a separate explicit deletion request is made.
exclusions: No new renderer implementation or arbitrary JSON/Markdown/HTML parser.
No screen-reader vendor certification claim; the CI lane validates Chromium's accessibility tree and structural semantics.
No deletion of historical process artifacts.
No automatic csm-browse invocation from csm-review; the browser lane remains CI-owned.

design.automaticFlow: validated terminal findings JSON -> session policy resolves interactionMode/share -> explicit generatedAt/projection IDs from host -> publishHumanFindings -> disposable Markdown/HTML output; projection failure is reported without touching JSON authority
design.browserFlow: CI browser job -> pinned Node/pnpm install -> start synthetic findings HTML server -> ensure isolated csm-browse session -> open page -> inspect DOM + Accessibility.getFullAXTree + console/network -> write bounded summary -> close session in finally
design.researchFlow: historical terminal finding remains unchanged -> separate explicitly owned csm-deep-research successor/erratum records current implementation and links prior artifact -> index successor without a latest alias
design.cleanupFlow: dry-run stale-session inventory -> validate each candidate under csm-browse runtime root -> remove only stale sessions through existing sweep -> re-run inventory; never touch .agents process artifacts
design.failurePolicy: Interactive projection is best-effort for human display but never changes canonical review success; browser CI fails when required and reports unavailable infrastructure clearly; cleanup stops on path ambiguity.
